title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_de_salamina_a_las_malvinas_by_miguel_del_rey_2178c (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_de_salamina_a_las_malvinas_by_miguel_del_rey_2178c' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
